messages:
Anya: flagged an oddity after daily restore smoke — 5/6 snapshots show metadata.encrypted=true but S3 head-object shows SSE=AES256; restores failing with KMS AccessDenied.
Kyle: yikes. can you paste the restore job id and a log snippet?
Anya: restore job rstr-87321 (2024-08-11T03:22Z). logs:
```
2024-08-11T03:22:12Z ERROR RestoreRunner Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/restore-runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789
```
Javier: did we rotate the uploader identity last night? we had a platform change that created backup-uploader-v2.
Linh: yep, the RBAC job rotated the uploader to service-account backup-uploader-v2 to tighten perms. I thought the kms grants were part of the rotation flow. will check the job run.
Anya: digging into S3 objects for those snapshots: head-object shows `ServerSideEncryption: AES256` while snapshot service metadata includes `encrypted: "true"`. so metadata says encrypted but actual object is AES256. mismatch.
BackupBot: Automated alert: snapshot-metadata/inconsistency detected for snapshot-2024-08-11-03 — encryption_flag=true but s3-sse=AES256 (detected at 2024-08-11T04:01Z).
Kyle: hypothesis: uploader attempted to use SSE-KMS but didn't include SSE header because it lacks kms:Encrypt on the key, so S3 fell back to bucket default AES256. snapshot service recorded `encrypted=true` before upload completed. result: metadata mismatch + restore fails due to missing kms:Decrypt grant for restore-runner.
Oncall: what's the immediate mitigation? can we re-encrypt objects or grant temporary access?
Javier: two short-term options: 1) grant kms:Decrypt to restore-runner for that key so restores succeed immediately (fast but broad); 2) re-encrypt affected objects by doing an S3 CopyObject specifying `--sse aws:kms` (requires kms:Encrypt for whoever does the copy). Either requires ACL/audit.
Linh: i'll check the rotation job logs and the grant creation step. if the grant creation failed, PR might have missed a retry. will also check the IAM change window.
Anya: proposed preflight checklist additions to prevent recurrence:
```bash
# verify object SSE vs metadata
aws s3api head-object --bucket snaps-prod --key snapshots/2024/08/11/snap-87321.tgz | jq '.ServerSideEncryption, .Metadata.encrypted'

# verify KMS grants for restore-runner and uploader
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-snapshots | jq '.Grants[] | select(.GranteePrincipal | contains("restore-runner") or contains("backup-uploader"))'

# quick decrypt smoke test (run using restore-runner creds)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.ct --key-id alias/redwood-snapshots
```
Kyle: also recommend an alert rule: if metadata.encrypted==true and ServerSideEncryption!="aws:kms" -> P1 page (paging team + oncall).
Linh: agreed. i'll open a PR to the rotation job to add a post-rotation verification step: check that grants exist for both the uploader principal and restore-runner, that head-object shows aws:kms for a sample object, and fail the rotation (roll back) if any check fails. will also add a short unit test to simulate missing kms perms in rotation CI.
Anya: immediate plan — request temporary grant to restore-runner and start a controlled reencrypt job. steps: 1) Linh to confirm grant logs; 2) Anya to kick off re-encrypt (S3 copy) once grant in place; 3) Kyle to add alert rule and runbook patch.
Linh: checking grant logs now — i see grant create failed with a 400 in the rotation run at 03:18. root cause looks like a race: rotation job created new principal, then attempted to create grant immediately before the principal was fully propagated. will add a small backoff + retry.
BackupBot: GrantRequest created: GR-20240811-51 by Anya. status: pending.
Oncall: ack. please post progress.
Anya: started re-encrypt job (S3 copy with --sse aws:kms). progress: 12/120 objects copied so far. re-encrypt uses ephemeral worker with kms:Encrypt and s3:PutObject.
Kyle: once reencrypt done, we should run an audit script across recent snapshots to detect any other mismatches and backfill reencrypts if needed. i'll add that to the runbook.
Anya: created runbook patch PR with commands, alerting, and preflight checklist. PR link: https://repo/redwood/encops/compare/rotation-preflight
Linh: i'll follow up with a rotation job fix (retry/backoff) and a CI test. also adding logs to the rotation pipeline for grant creation outputs so we can trace failures faster.
Javier: for postmortem, capture timeline + root cause (grant create raced principal propagation) + mitigation (preflight + retry + alert).
Oncall: thanks all. paging rules updated; i'll close the P1 when reencrypt finishes and restores validate.
Anya: will update here when reencrypt completes.
